description: This file implements the Google Maps provider as part of a larger mapping integration, offering methods for searching places and getting directions via Google Maps API.

classes.name: GoogleMapsProvider
classes.description: Implementation of MapsProvider using Google Maps API, providing place search and directions functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self, settings: Settings)
methods.description: Initializes the provider with settings and checks for Google Maps API key.

methods.name: list[PlaceCandidate] search_places(self, request: PlaceSearchRequest)
methods.description: Searches for places based on a query and optional location and radius, returning a list of place candidates.

methods.name: RouteSummary get_directions(self, request: DirectionsRequest)
methods.description: Retrieves directions from origin to destination, returning a route summary with distance, duration, polyline, and steps.

ctags.name: get_directions
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_directions(self, request: DirectionsRequest) -> RouteSummary:$/

ctags.name: search_places
ctags.pattern: /^    async def search_places(self, request: PlaceSearchRequest) -> list[PlaceCandidate]:$/
